title: Dolores Huerta, United Farm Workers co-founder, dies at 96
dek: Huerta co-founded the union that became the United Farm Workers. Her family announced her death on 28 October 2026.
what: Dolores Huerta died on Wednesday 28 October 2026 at the age of 96. Her family announced it in a statement on Instagram, which ABC News quotes: "We are deeply saddened to announce that our beloved mother, Dolores Huerta, has passed away today." The reports I read do not give a cause or a place of death.

Huerta co-founded the National Farm Workers Association with Cesar Chavez and Gilbert Padilla in the 1960s. It became the United Farm Workers. ABC News says her work won the first farmworker union contracts in the United States. She received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2012.
CNN and NBC News both posted the news on X within minutes of each other, and each describes her as a co-founder of the United Farm Workers.
why: A figure known across labor, civil rights and Latino politics has died, and outlets from every desk posted the news at once.
next: Funeral and memorial plans, if her family announces them.

sources.label: ABC News: Labor rights leader Dolores Huerta dies at 96
